messages:
sara (People Ops): quick org heads-up — small leadership shift in Eng + two backfills. TL;DR: joel will take interim lead for runtime infra, mike h gets an IC lead to support, and we’re opening 2 SWE hires + 1 infra eng. :tada:

ajay (VP Eng): thanks! adding context: this is not a reorg, just temporary redistribution while we recruit. priority is stability for the runtime roadmap.

mike h (Eng Manager): clarifying — i'll keep day-to-day on call rotations and release cadence. joel will handle infra prioritization & kernel optimization decisions.

joel (Director, Runtime): yep. i'll also run the weekly runtime sync for the next 8 weeks. can someone add me to the deploy and perf dashboards?

clara (Recruiter): noted. i'll request access for @joel and ping infra tooling to add him. posting the hiring plan below:
- Role A: SWE (inference-serving) — 1.0 FTE, IC-2/3
- Role B: Infra Engineer (GPU infra) — 1.0 FTE, IC-3
- Role C: SWE (runtime integrations) — optional, we'll assess after first two

emma (Talent Sourcer): opening reqs today for Role A/B. ETA first CVs by EOD Friday. will share a shortlist and ask for tech screeners.

sara (People Ops): backfills have approved budget. proposal: 4-week hiring sprint, with target offers by May 9. onboarding checklist will be ready and onboarding-bot will create seats.

onboarding-bot: Created onboarding checklist for new hires. Links: https://redwood/internal/onboard/checklist — Next actions: assign buddy, create laptop request.

mike h (Eng Manager): can we get a rotation buddy for new infra hire? i can mentor but would prefer a senior buddy from eng-platform. @ajay any suggestions?

ajay (VP Eng): ask @laura (eng-platform lead) — she'll be good. i'll reach out.

clara (Recruiter): quick Q: do we want remote-first candidates or prefer Bay area for infra role?

ajay (VP Eng): remote-first is fine, but preference for overlap with PST for on-call. note it for job posting.

joel (Director, Runtime): for interviews, please include a perf debugging exercise and a kernel/quantization discussion. i'll own the tech take.

emma (Talent Sourcer): will add perf debugging to loop. scheduled a 30-min sync with @joel tomorrow 10am PT to align on rubric.

sara (People Ops): action items summary:
1) clara/emma — post reqs + shortlist (due Fri)
2) joel — interview rubric and perf exercise (tomorrow 10am)
3) ajay — coordinate buddy with laura
4) mike h — maintain releases/oncall
5) onboarding-bot — create onboarding checklist & laptop ticket

mike h (Eng Manager): thanks all. small ask — can we make the infra hire's offer package include a relocation stipend if they need overlap weeks for ramp? cc: @sara

sara (People Ops): noted. i'll include a relocation/overlap stipend option in the offer template.

ajay (VP Eng): appreciate the speedy coordination. we want minimal churn — keep me posted if hiring timeline shifts. :thumbsup:

clara (Recruiter): will update this thread with candidate shortlists and interview panel.

joel (Director, Runtime): thanks — excited to get the extra hands on perf. :rocket:

sara (People Ops): closing thread for now. follow-ups will be in the hiring tracker and interview calendar invites. feel free to DM for urgent items. :wave:
